1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.

6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

subtitles.en: So it means that over two million clients have lost services as a result of the reductions in US government funding.

subtitles.zh: 所以显然，援助行业正在经历
subtitles.en: And so obviously the aid sector is going through

subtitles.zh: 这种痛苦的重组，真的，
subtitles.en: this traumatic, rebalancing, really,

subtitles.zh: 世界上最需要帮助的人，身处危机地区，

subtitles.zh: 您将这种情况称为“新世界失序”。我想问您埃博拉作为一个代表性事例，正如您所说，它一直在传播。

subtitles.zh: 我们现在在肯尼亚看到一例病例。我想知道您如何看待全球公共卫生体系。

subtitles.zh: 鉴于所有这些资金都被削减，它受到了多大的削弱？
subtitles.en: How handicapped is it in light of the fact that all this funding has been cut?

subtitles.zh: 我经历过其他埃博拉疫情，我觉得那时即使不是很多人最关心的，
subtitles.en: I have lived through other Ebola outbreaks where I feel like it was, if not front of mind for a lot of people,

subtitles.zh: 也比现在更常出现在报纸头版。您认为它会如何结束？
subtitles.en: more often on the front pages of newspapers than it is now. How do you see it ending?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，它将伴随着大量伤亡而结束。
subtitles.en: Well, it will end with large numbers of casualties.

subtitles.zh: 目前，检测率相当低，
subtitles.en: At the moment, the rate of detection is quite low,

subtitles.zh: 但在被检测出感染埃博拉的人中，一半正在死亡。
subtitles.en: but among those who are detected as having Ebola, half of them are dying.
